points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 朱尔斯·马扎然出生于意大利皮翁比诺的一个意大利贵族家庭。原名朱利奥·拉梅奥利·马扎里诺，父亲是一名来自西西里岛的贵族，母亲是那不勒斯人。他在罗马接受教育，先后在罗马大学和阿尔卡拉大学学习法律，展现出非凡的才智和语言天赋，精通多种语言包括意大利语、法语、西班牙语、德语和拉丁语。这段早期教育为他日后在外交界的发展奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: Jules Mazarin was born in Piombino, Italy to an Italian noble family. Originally named Giulio Raimondo Mazzarino, his father was a Sicilian nobleman and his mother was from Naples. He received his education in Rome, studying law at both the University of Rome and the University of Alcalá. He demonstrated exceptional intelligence and linguistic talent, mastering multiple languages including Italian, French, Spanish, German, and Latin. This early education laid a solid foundation for his future diplomatic career.

points.title: 教廷外交官
points.description: 1624年，马扎然进入罗马教廷服务，成为教皇乌尔班八世的秘书。他凭借出色的外交才能迅速崭露头角，被任命为教廷驻法国大使。1630年，他成功调解了法国与西班牙之间的冲突，展现了卓越的外交手腕。1634年，他被任命为红衣主教，正式步入教廷高层。在罗马期间，他积累了丰富的政治经验和人脉关系，同时积累了巨额财富，为他日后在法国政坛的发展奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1624, Mazarin entered the service of the Papal Court as secretary to Pope Urban VIII. With his exceptional diplomatic skills, he quickly rose through the ranks and was appointed as the Papal Nuncio to France. In 1630, he successfully mediated conflicts between France and Spain, demonstrating outstanding diplomatic abilities. In 1634, he was appointed as a cardinal, formally entering the higher echelons of the Church. During his time in Rome, he accumulated extensive political experience and connections, as well as considerable wealth, laying the foundation for his future career in French politics.

points.title: 进入法国政坛
points.description: 1639年，马扎然应法国首相黎塞留的邀请来到巴黎，成为其助手。黎塞留看中了他的外交才能和政治智慧。1641年，黎塞留临终前将他推荐给路易十三，马扎然被任命为法国国务大臣。1642年黎塞留去世后，马扎然迅速填补权力真空，成为路易十三的首席顾问。他继续推行黎塞留的中央集权政策，强化王权，同时开始为自己在法国政坛的地位奠定基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1639, Mazarin was invited to Paris by French Prime Minister Cardinal Richelieu to become his assistant. Richelieu recognized his diplomatic talents and political wisdom. In 1641, on his deathbed, Richelieu recommended him to Louis XIII, and Mazarin was appointed as a Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs. After Richelieu's death in 1642, Mazarin quickly filled the power vacuum and became the chief advisor to Louis XIII. He continued Richelieu's policies of centralization and strengthening royal authority, while simultaneously establishing his own position in French politics.

points.title: 摄政时期
points.description: 1643年路易十三去世，年幼的路易十四继位，马扎然成为摄政王奥地利的安妮的首席顾问。他继续推行黎塞留和路易十三的政策，强化中央集权，对抗贵族势力。1648年，他签署了《威斯特伐利亚和约》，结束了三十年战争，为法国赢得了阿尔萨斯地区等重要领土。然而，他的意大利背景和奢华生活方式引发法国贵族的不满，导致1648-1653年的投石党运动。尽管面临叛乱，马扎然成功维护了王权，并在1651年暂时离开法国以平息局势。
points.descriptionEn: Upon Louis XIII's death in 1643, the young Louis XIV ascended the throne, and Mazarin became the chief advisor to the regent, Anne of Austria. He continued the policies of Richelieu and Louis XIII, strengthening central authority and resisting noble power. In 1648, he signed the Peace of Westphalia, ending the Thirty Years' War and securing important territories like Alsace for France. However, his Italian background and lavish lifestyle provoked discontent among French nobles, leading to the Fronde rebellion (1648-1653). Despite the rebellion, Mazarin successfully preserved royal authority and temporarily left France in 1651 to quell the situation.

points.title: 晚年统治
points.description: 1651年，马扎然返回法国，继续担任路易十四的首席顾问。他成功镇压了投石党运动的残余势力，巩固了王权。1659年，他签订了《比利牛斯和约》，结束了与西班牙的战争，使法国获得了鲁西永和部分佛兰德地区。马扎然还致力于文化艺术的发展，建立了著名的马扎然图书馆，成为法国国家图书馆的前身。他培养了年轻的路易十四，教导他治国之道，为法国的绝对君主制奠定了基础。1661年马扎然去世，临终前推荐科尔贝作为财政大臣，路易十四开始亲政，开启了法国的辉煌时代。
points.descriptionEn: In 1651, Mazarin returned to France and continued as chief advisor to Louis XIV. He successfully suppressed the remnants of the Fronde rebellion, consolidating royal authority. In 1659, he signed the Treaty of the Pyrenees, ending the war with Spain and gaining Roussillon and parts of Flanders for France. Mazarin also contributed to cultural and artistic development, establishing the Bibliothèque Mazarine, which became the predecessor to the French National Library. He mentored the young Louis XIV, teaching him the principles of governance, laying the foundation for French absolutism. Mazarin died in 1661, recommending Jean-Baptiste Colbert as finance minister, after which Louis XIV began his personal reign, ushering in France's golden age.

supporter.zh: 马扎然被视为法国历史上最杰出的政治家之一。他成功延续了黎塞留的中央集权政策，维护了法国的王权和国家统一。在外交领域，他通过签订《威斯特伐利亚和约》和《比利牛斯和约》，极大地扩展了法国的领土和影响力。他培养年轻的路易十四，为法国的绝对君主制奠定了基础，开启了法国的辉煌时代。马扎然还重视文化教育，建立了马扎然图书馆，促进了法国的文化繁荣。
supporter.en: Mazarin is regarded as one of France's most outstanding statesmen. He successfully continued Richelieu's policies of centralization, preserving royal authority and national unity. In diplomacy, he expanded French territory and influence through treaties like the Peace of Westphalia and the Treaty of the Pyrenees. He mentored the young Louis XIV, laying the foundation for French absolutism and ushering in France's golden age. Mazarin also valued cultural education, establishing the Bibliothèque Mazarine and promoting cultural prosperity in France.

critic.zh: 批评者认为马扎然是一个机会主义者，他的意大利背景使他始终被视为外来者。他的奢华生活方式和积累的巨额财富引发了法国贵族的不满，直接导致了投石党运动。他过度依赖外国顾问，特别是意大利人，削弱了法国本土精英的影响力。此外，他强化王权的政策虽然巩固了国家统一，但也压制了地方自治和贵族特权，为后来的法国大革命埋下了伏笔。
critic.en: Critics view Mazarin as an opportunist whose Italian background always marked him as an outsider. His lavish lifestyle and accumulated wealth provoked discontent among French nobility, directly leading to the Fronde rebellion. He relied excessively on foreign advisors, particularly Italians, diminishing the influence of French elites. Furthermore, while his policies of strengthening royal authority preserved national unity, they also suppressed local autonomy and noble privileges, sowing seeds for the French Revolution.

objective.zh: 历史学界普遍认为马扎然是一位复杂而重要的过渡性人物。他成功地将黎塞留开创的绝对君主制延续并发展，为路易十四的统治奠定了基础。在法国历史上，他被视为从黎塞留到科尔贝这一重要政治链条中的关键环节。尽管面临争议，但马扎然的外交成就和对法国领土扩张的贡献不容忽视。在流行文化中，他常被描绘为精明而神秘的政治家，其与奥地利的安妮的关系也成为历史小说和戏剧的常见题材。
objective.en: Historians generally regard Mazarin as a complex and transitional figure who successfully continued and developed the absolutist system initiated by Richelieu, laying the foundation for Louis XIV's reign. In French history, he is seen as a crucial link in the political chain from Richelieu to Colbert. Despite controversies, Mazarin's diplomatic achievements and contributions to territorial expansion are significant. In popular culture, he is often portrayed as a shrewd and mysterious statesman, with his relationship with Anne of Austria becoming a common theme in historical novels and dramas.

self.zh: 政治就像下棋，有时候需要牺牲一些棋子来赢得整个游戏。
self.en: Politics is like chess; sometimes you have to sacrifice some pieces to win the game.

others.zh: 马扎然是法国历史上最伟大的政治家之一，他不仅延续了黎塞留的事业，还为法国的辉煌未来奠定了基础。
others.en: Mazarin was one of the greatest statesmen in French history; not only did he continue Richelieu's work, but he also laid the foundation for France's glorious future.
